name: use-bookings
title: useAvailableSlots
description: useAvailableSlots: the bookings block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the bookings block (`npx better-supabase add bookings`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/bookings.
